name: Venomancer: Celerity replaces Spider Form speed instead of stacking with it (#8723)
contract: #8723 expected Celerity (804962) to add its 60% to Spider Form (800841) and Versatile and Deadly for 190% run speed. Spell.dbc, the Exiles DB, coatavern and the SUB dump agree that Celerity effect 0 and Spider Form effect 0 are both aura 31 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED (Celerity BasePoints 59 DieSides 1 = 60, Spider Form BasePoints 19 DieSides 1 = 20). Versatile and Deadly rank 2 (681492) effect 1 is a flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 (aura 107, misc 3) of +10 with class mask word0 0x400, which selects Spider Form (SpellFamilyFlags word0 1024), so it raises Spider Form's own aura 31 to 30 rather than adding a separate speed aura. Unit::UpdateSpeed takes only the largest positive aura 31 amount for unmounted run speed, so Celerity's 60 replaces Spider Form's 20 or 30 and both players run at 160%. Neither tooltip promises stacking: Celerity says it increases movement speed by 60%. A control without the talent and a talent player each enter Spider Form and cast Celerity, so the talent is the only difference.

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
SETUP: Versatile and Deadly rank 2 is applied
Control Spider Form aura carries speed 20
Talent Spider Form aura carries speed 30
Spider Form alone runs at 120% without the talent
Spider Form alone runs at 130% with the talent
Talent Spider Form stays active under Celerity
Celerity in Spider Form runs at 160% without the talent
Celerity in Spider Form also runs at 160% with the talent
